subject.title: feat(onboard): streamline setup with agent-assisted configuration

question: Should this PR own both the channel JSON metadata contract and the official ClawHub trust/provenance policy, including npmSpec-only official ClawHub trusted installs, or should that trust decision stay in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98875?
rationale: The implementation is focused and tested, but deciding which external install records receive official metadata, drift/update treatment, and trusted runtime plugin status is a compatibility and security-boundary policy choice.

options.title: Approve current combined policy
options.body: Land this PR if maintainers want it to own both channel JSON metadata and the official ClawHub provenance/trust predicate, then retire or rebase the overlapping narrower trust PR.

options.title: Split trust from metadata
options.body: Keep the channel JSON metadata work here and move the npmSpec-only trusted-install policy to the narrower open trust PR before landing either path.

options.title: Add legacy repair first
options.body: Require a doctor, update, or migration repair path for older bare official ClawHub records before tightening provenance-dependent drift and update behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve current combined policy
recommendation.body: Land this PR if maintainers want it to own both channel JSON metadata and the official ClawHub provenance/trust predicate, then retire or rebase the overlapping narrower trust PR.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged onboarding and official install-trust history makes them the best available owner for the cross-cutting setup and trust-boundary choice.
